title: Add Voronoi Chart Mark

complexity.rationale: This codebase already builds Vega `voronoi`-transform paths internally as invisible hover hit-targets for Scatter/Line (packages/vega-spec-builder-s2/src/marks/markUtils.ts, ~lines 362-424: the point-collection and voronoi-path-mark helpers used for tooltips/popovers). Making a standalone Voronoi mark is largely reusing that exact transform and mark-construction logic, just rendering the cell paths visibly (stroked, not aria-hidden) instead of as invisible hit targets, with the underlying site points promoted to the primary accessible/keyboard unit instead of the cells.

summary: An x/y/label mark rendering a Voronoi tessellation as the primary visualization — reusing this codebase's existing internal voronoi-transform hit-target logic (markUtils.ts) but making the cells visible strokes and the site points the accessible unit (distinct from RSC's existing internal voronoi hover overlays on other marks).
requirements: Accepts `x`, `y` (required) and an optional `label` channel; one Voronoi cell and one site point per row
Builds the tessellation via the same Vega `voronoi` transform this codebase already uses internally for hover hit-targets (markUtils.ts), reused rather than reimplemented
Cell polygons render as visible stroked paths and are `aria-hidden` (cells are hit-targets/visual only, not the accessible unit)
Site markers (the underlying points) are the keyboard-focusable, screen-reader-exposed, and tooltip-triggering elements — not the cells

edgeCases.expectedBehavior: The Vega voronoi transform degenerates to one cell spanning the full plot bounds; render it without error.

Degenerate (zero-area) cells are possible for exact duplicates — document as expected rather than a bug, consistent with how the existing internal voronoi hit-target usage already handles duplicate points.
Hover/tooltip targets the site point whose cell contains the cursor, reusing the same interaction behavior as the existing internal voronoi hover overlays.
Cell stroke and site point fill resolve through the existing colorScheme-aware color scale.
S1-only for this spec; no S2 port until the mark stabilizes out of rc status.
Screen readers and keyboard navigation must never land on a cell path (aria-hidden), only on site points, per requirements.

crossCutting.notes: touchesTooltipOrPopover: site points support ChartTooltip/ChartPopover, and hover detection reuses the exact voronoi-transform + hover-signal wiring markUtils.ts already provides for Scatter/Line — this mark is closer to 'exposing existing internal machinery as a first-class visual' than building new interaction plumbing. requiresNewSignalOrScale: false — no new scale type; x/y are plain continuous scales like Scatter. requiresS1S2Parity: false because this ships as a new s1-only rc-status mark, matching the Donut/BigNumber precedent; revisit once promoted out of rc.

implementationPlan.change: Create VoronoiOptions/VoronoiOptionsWithDefaults/VoronoiSpecOptions with required `x`/`y` fields and an optional `label` field.
Add VoronoiOptions to the MarkOptions union.
Fully-populated defaultVoronoiOptions fixture, including a duplicate-coordinate variant.

Generalize the existing voronoi-points and voronoi-path helpers (~lines 362-424) so they can be called for a visible/primary mark, not only an invisible hit-target overlay — e.g. an `aria-hidden`/stroke-visibility parameter instead of assuming hidden-overlay defaults.
getVoronoiCellMark (visible stroked path, aria-hidden, built via the generalized markUtils.ts helper), getVoronoiSitePointMark (the accessible/keyboard-focusable symbol per row).

addVoronoi, addData (reuses the existing point-collection helper from markUtils.ts), addSignals (reuses existing hover/tooltip signal helpers), setScales (plain continuous x/y scales, reusing addContinuousDimensionScale/addMetricScale).
Unit tests for getVoronoiCellMark/getVoronoiSitePointMark using the fixture, asserting aria-hidden on cells and accessible attributes on site points.
Register voronoiCount: -1 in initializeComponentCounts, import addVoronoi, add the 'voronoi' switch case.
VoronoiProps/VoronoiElement, Omit-ing only fields replaced at the React boundary (ChartTooltip/ChartPopover children).
Render-null component holding prop defaults, placed under rc/ per the Donut/BigNumber rc-status precedent.
Import Voronoi from '../rc' and add its displayName dispatch case.
Add Voronoi to the sanitizeRscChartChildren import/list from '../rc'.
Update the toStrictEqual ChartOptions snapshot to include the new mark type at default values.
Basic story showing visible cell strokes and site points.

openQuestions: Confirm the existing markUtils.ts voronoi helpers can be safely generalized without changing behavior for their current Scatter/Line hover-overlay callers — may warrant a small refactor PR of its own before this mark is built.
Should cell stroke color be a fixed neutral tone or theme/data-driven (e.g. colored by an implicit category)?
